_comment: The rendering domain benchmarks the engine through its internal `#*` subpath imports (resolved in the browser page by the driver's Vite alias, never in the Node CLI); the `#* -> ../../src/*` path reproduces the root package.json wildcard for the type-checker. The physics domain instead imports the `@codexo/exojs-physics` package (which itself imports the `@codexo/exojs` barrel), and the rendering extension arms import `@codexo/exojs-particles` and `@codexo/exojs-tilemap`; none of those expose a `@codexo/exojs-source` export condition, and their package entries point at `dist`, which the type-check runs without, so their entries are mapped to source here; `@codexo/exojs-particles-source` is in `customConditions` for the same reason one level down, since `@codexo/exojs-particles` resolves its own `#*` imports through a package `imports` map that otherwise lands on stale `dist` declarations — mirroring the runtime aliasing in scripts/glsl-loader.ts and vitest.config.ts's aliasConfig.
